essential.label: Essential
essential.desc: Fast first-timer route with the non-negotiable highlights.

signature.label: Signature
signature.desc: Balanced RoamWise default with breathing room and strong variety.

deep-dive.label: Deep Dive
deep-dive.desc: Slower route with secondary places, culture and recovery time.

expedition.label: Expedition
expedition.desc: Longest ready-made route with remote legs, buffers and deeper exploration.

destinations.name: Ladakh High-Altitude Circuit
destinations.notes: High altitude: preserve acclimatization, hydration and road buffers. Recheck permits and road status locally.

destinations.name: Kashmir Valley & Alpine Lakes
destinations.notes: Mountain access and security conditions can change. Keep routes flexible and verify local advisories.

destinations.name: Spiti Valley Himalayan Loop
destinations.notes: Long road days, altitude and seasonal closures define this circuit. Do not compress acclimatization or night driving.

destinations.name: Manali, Solang & Kullu Valley
destinations.notes: Activities and high-road access are weather dependent. Use licensed operators for adventure sports.

destinations.name: Kumaon: Almora, Binsar, Jageshwar & Munsiyari
destinations.notes: Mountain roads are slow and monsoon-sensitive. Keep one flexible buffer on longer loops.

destinations.name: Char Dham Scarlet Pilgrim Path
destinations.notes: Pilgrimage registrations, transport rules, trekking access and weather can change. Verify official Uttarakhand updates.

destinations.name: Rishikesh & Mussoorie Escape
destinations.notes: River activities are seasonal and regulated. Use authorized rafting/adventure operators.

destinations.name: Rajasthan Royal Desert Circuit
destinations.notes: Desert temperatures swing sharply. Heritage sites can be crowded; start early and preserve water/rest.

destinations.name: Delhi - Agra - Jaipur Golden Triangle
destinations.notes: Book major monuments ahead where useful and avoid unrealistic same-day city hopping.

destinations.name: Varanasi & Ayodhya Sacred Cities
destinations.notes: Respect religious queues, local restrictions and photography rules around active worship spaces.

destinations.name: Goa Coast, Heritage & Hinterland
destinations.notes: Waterfall and wildlife access is seasonal. Avoid unsafe swimming and unofficial adventure operators.

destinations.name: Kerala Backwaters, Hills & Coast
destinations.notes: Monsoon changes road and water conditions. Wildlife and boating activities depend on local operations.

destinations.name: Andaman Islands Dive & Beach Circuit
destinations.notes: Keep a ferry/weather buffer. Marine activities should use licensed operators and respect reef rules.

destinations.name: Sikkim Monasteries & High Lakes
destinations.notes: Protected-area permits, altitude and road conditions govern high-lake and North Sikkim access.

destinations.name: North-East Grand Expedition
destinations.notes: Permits, wildlife seasons and mountain roads vary by state. Preserve at least one contingency day.

destinations.name: Tawang & Sela Pass Circuit
destinations.notes: Arunachal permits and frontier-sector permissions are separate considerations. Verify before departure.

destinations.name: Meghalaya Cloud & Living Roots Circuit
destinations.notes: Heavy rain changes cave, waterfall and road safety. Use local guides for technical caves and remote trails.

destinations.name: Hampi, Badami & Deccan Ruins
destinations.notes: Midday heat is intense outside winter. Use early starts and protect fragile heritage surfaces.

destinations.name: Great Rann of Kutch & Craft Villages
destinations.notes: Salt-desert access and festival logistics are seasonal. Long drives need daylight and fuel planning.

destinations.name: Lakshadweep Lagoon Escape
destinations.notes: Entry permissions and island access rules apply. Marine transfers are weather dependent.

destinations.name: Sri Lanka Cultural Triangle to South Coast
destinations.notes: Rail, wildlife and monsoon patterns vary by region; keep transport reservations and weather in view.

destinations.name: Thailand Bangkok, North & Islands
destinations.notes: Avoid wildlife attractions that rely on harmful animal handling. Marine trips depend on seasonal sea conditions.

destinations.name: Bali Temples, Volcanoes & Coast
destinations.notes: Traffic can consume hours. Volcano hikes and boat trips need weather-aware licensed operators.

destinations.name: Vietnam North-to-South Highlights
destinations.notes: Domestic transport is efficient but long; avoid stacking flights, trains and tours too tightly.

destinations.name: Japan Tokyo - Kyoto - Alps
destinations.notes: Peak seasons sell out quickly. Use rail strategically rather than assuming one pass is always best value.

destinations.name: South Korea Seoul, Busan & Jeju
destinations.notes: Some tours require passport details and fixed booking. Weather can affect Jeju flights/ferries.

destinations.name: Dubai & Abu Dhabi Future-Desert Circuit
destinations.notes: Desert heat is serious outside winter. Use licensed operators and respect dress/behavior rules at religious sites.

destinations.name: Türkiye Istanbul, Cappadocia & Aegean
destinations.notes: Balloon flights and boats are weather dependent. Historic sites reward early starts.

destinations.name: Egypt Nile & Desert Civilizations
destinations.notes: Use licensed guides/transport where helpful and protect against heat. Site access and museum locations can change.

destinations.name: Italy Rome, Florence & Venice
destinations.notes: Major museums and attractions can require timed entry. Avoid overpacking too many cities into short trips.

destinations.name: Swiss Alps Grand Rail Circuit
destinations.notes: Mountain visibility and cable-car operations are weather dependent. Check point-to-point fares against passes.

destinations.name: Iceland Ring Road & Highlands Edge
destinations.notes: Wind, road closures and rapidly changing weather are the main planning constraints. Never ignore road advisories.

destinations.name: Greece Athens, Islands & Meteora
destinations.notes: Ferry schedules and winds shape island plans. Avoid connecting a critical flight directly after a long ferry.

destinations.name: New Zealand South Island Road Expedition
destinations.notes: Driving distances are deceptive. Preserve daylight, weather buffers and rest between major adventure days.

destinations.name: Kenya & Tanzania Great Migration Safari
destinations.notes: Migration location varies by month and year. Use reputable operators and avoid crowding wildlife.

destinations.name: Nepal Kathmandu, Pokhara & Chitwan
destinations.notes: Mountain weather can affect domestic flights. Wildlife experiences should follow park rules and ethical distance.

destinations.name: Bhutan Paro, Thimphu & Punakha
destinations.notes: Entry, guide and sustainable-development rules depend on nationality and current policy; verify official requirements.

destinations.name: Maldives Atoll Reset
destinations.notes: Seaplane/boat transfers are schedule and weather dependent. Follow local-island dress and marine-conservation rules.

destinations.name: Everest Base Camp Trek
destinations.notes: Serious altitude itinerary: never remove acclimatization merely to match a short request. Weather can disrupt Lukla flights.

destinations.name: Annapurna Circuit & Thorong La
destinations.notes: Thorong La is a serious high pass. Weather, altitude and local trail advice override a preset schedule.

destinations.name: Kilimanjaro Summit Expedition
destinations.notes: Use a licensed operator and a route length that supports acclimatization. Summit success is never guaranteed.

destinations.name: Inca Trail to Machu Picchu
destinations.notes: Classic trail permits are limited and guide rules apply. Acclimatize in Cusco/Sacred Valley before the trek.

destinations.name: Tour du Mont Blanc
destinations.notes: Hut bookings are competitive and weather changes quickly. Variants should not encourage unsafe rushing over passes.

destinations.name: Torres del Paine W Trek
destinations.notes: Patagonian wind and weather are serious. Reserve camps/refugios and keep a flexible buffer.

destinations.name: Markha Valley Trek
destinations.notes: Arrive acclimatized in Leh before starting. High-pass weather and river conditions dictate safe progress.

destinations.name: Kashmir Great Lakes Trek
destinations.notes: Season, permits and local security conditions matter. Use a reputable trekking operator and keep a buffer day.

destinations.name: Hampta Pass & Chandratal Trek
destinations.notes: Pass and Chandratal access are seasonal. Do not force the lake extension if roads or weather are unsafe.

destinations.name: Chadar Frozen River Trek
destinations.notes: Extreme cold and unstable ice make this a specialist guided expedition. Official opening and on-ground ice assessment are mandatory.
